python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# July 2010
v_2010_gold = 11041
v_2010_sdr = 56013
v_2010_fc = 49743
v_2010_rp = 12330

# July 2011
v_2011_gold = 11041
v_2011_sdr = 57182
v_2011_fc = 54635
v_2011_rp = 23024

# July 2012
v_2012_gold = 11041
v_2012_sdr = 54011
v_2012_fc = 50293
v_2012_rp = 34039

# July 2013
v_2013_gold = 11041
v_2013_sdr = 54214
v_2013_fc = 47688
v_2013_rp = 34483

# All 16 values
values = [
    v_2010_gold, v_2010_sdr, v_2010_fc, v_2010_rp,
    v_2011_gold, v_2011_sdr, v_2011_fc, v_2011_rp,
    v_2012_gold, v_2012_sdr, v_2012_fc, v_2012_rp,
    v_2013_gold, v_2013_sdr, v_2013_fc, v_2013_rp
]

print("All 16 values:")
print(values)

# Calculate geometric mean: the nth root of the product of all values
# Or equivalently: exp(sum(ln(x)) / n)

log_sum = sum(math.log(v) for v in values)
geometric_mean = math.exp(log_sum / len(values))

print(f"\nGeometric mean (high precision): {geometric_mean}")
print(f"Geometric mean (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(geometric_mean, 2)}")
EOF
